name: Tanteibu: The Detective Club -Tantei to Yuurei to Kaitou to-
original_name: たんていぶ THE DETECTIVE CLUB -探偵と幽霊と怪盗と-
source: First in the four volume romantic detective story. The detective team consists of Maya, Tora and Natsu, three teenage girls and Sodom, a little robot with a useful set of skills. Each game in the series focuses on three different cases you have to solve.
